{{Top|leg}}
'''Podpoppers''' were a type of [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] grown in [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponic gardens]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] grew them in his garden along with [[Pallie/Legends|pallies]], a [[Hubba gourd/Legends|hubba gourds]], [[bloddle]]s, [[Bristlemelon/Legends|bristlemelons]].
